The sequence features — particularly the NAD-binding "GK" motifs combined with the protein length — are consistent with **type I dehydroquinate dehydratase (AroD)**, an enzyme in the shikimate biosynthesis pathway. The correct net reaction catalyzed by this enzyme is the dehydration of 3-dehydroquinate to 3-dehydroshikimate with release of water, consistent with EC 4.2.1.10 (dehydroquinate dehydratase, type I mechanism with NAD⁺ as cofactor).
